register.title: Register
register.noInvite: You need an invite link to register. Ask a maintainer of the circle for one.
register.invalidInvite: This invite link is invalid or has expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
register.checkError: Could not check the invite. Check your connection and try again.

password.loginNameHint: 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, _ and -. For signing in; other members do not see it.
password.displayNameHint: The name your recommendations are signed with, up to 64 characters. Your login name if left empty.

password.qrTitle: QR code for the authenticator app

errors.loginNameTaken: This login name is taken. Choose another one.
errors.displayNameInvalid: A display name has at most 64 characters and no control characters.
errors.passwordTooLong: The password is too long (at most 128 characters).
errors.passwordIsLoginName: The password must not be the login name.
errors.codeInvalid: The code is wrong. Check that the app has this key, wait for the next code and try again.
errors.enrolmentExpired: The registration timed out (15 minutes). Submit again; you will then scan a new code, and can delete the old entry from the app.
errors.network: Could not submit. Check your connection and try again.

session.error: Could not check whether you are signed in. Check your connection and try again.

locate.unsupported: This browser cannot determine your location.
locate.denied: No permission to use your location. Allow it in the browser settings.
locate.outside: Your location is outside the map of every city.

errors.cancelled: The passkey prompt was cancelled or timed out. Try again.
errors.address: Passkeys do not work at this address. Open the app at the address the invite link uses (for local testing: localhost, not 127.0.0.1).
errors.unsupported: This browser or device cannot use passkeys. Use a password and an authenticator app instead.
errors.unavailable: Passkeys are not available on this instance. Use a password and an authenticator app instead.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.

register.loginNameHint: 3 to 32 characters: letters a–z, digits, _ and -. You cannot change it later.
register.displayNameHint: What other members see. You can leave it empty to use your login name.

errors.invalidDisplayName: The display name can have at most 64 characters and no special control characters.
errors.loginNameTaken: This login name is taken. Choose another one.
errors.invalidInvite: This invite link is invalid or has expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
errors.verifyFailed: The passkey could not be verified. Try again.
errors.exists: This device already has a passkey for this account.

recoveryCodes.title: Save your recovery codes
recoveryCodes.explanation: If you lose your passkey, your phone or the authenticator app, sign in with a recovery code instead. Each code works once. Keep them in a password manager, or print them and keep them somewhere safe.
recoveryCodes.copyError: Could not copy. Select the codes by hand or download them.
recoveryCodes.shownOnce: The codes are shown only now: the server keeps only their hashes and cannot show them again.
recoveryCodes.confirm: I have saved these recovery codes
